purpose: Cover computeReadiness and the rcf define readiness CLI (AC-17501-1..6) with unit tests over fixture trees + a CLI spawn, plus a targeted test of the P3 loadAllLedgers fix.
title: computeReadiness and rcf define readiness CLI

testCases.description: computeReadiness returns { tree, delta, stages, nextAction, coverage, decisions, freezeable } and freezeable is true when every stage state is in { passed, acknowledged, notApplicable }.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/readiness.test.js::readiness: returns the section 2.4 shape and freezeable folds correctly

testCases.description: Fan-out: computeImpact runs once per id in changed union added; impacted is the deduplicated union; impactedFbs is the subset with kind 'fbs' AND actionNeeded 're-execute'.
coverage.tree is a tree-wide CoverageResult; coverage.delta is one CoverageResult per unique REQ ancestor of the delta ids.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/readiness.test.js::readiness: coverage tree-wide and per REQ ancestor

testCases.description: nextAction picks the first failing stage in D1..D8 order and the first failing check inside it, listing ids and a rcf define readiness --check <short-name> command; null when no stage is failing.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/readiness.test.js::readiness: nextAction picks first failing stage and check

testCases.description: The CLI prints text summary by default and JSON with --json; --check <stage> exits 4 on blocking failure, 0 with a [warn] on warn-with-ack unacknowledged failure, 0 otherwise; admissibility refusal exits 4.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/readiness.test.js::readiness cli: text output shape and --check exit codes

testCases.description: loadAllLedgers omits ledgers whose files are absent so computeDelta records no docHash for absent ledgers; a project with only brief-ledger.json sees exactly one ledger:brief docHash.
testCases.testPointer: test/define/ledgers.test.js::ledgers: loadAllLedgers omits absent ledger files
